case: all three objects get the effect

case: each object is sheared about its own center, not the selection's
expected: behaves the way someone would expect
observed: the first object is 134.641 pt wide; shearing it about its own center gives 134.641 pt. A live effect is applied to each object separately, so a multiple selection is not the same as Illustrator's own command, which shears the whole selection about one center.
